chars.AMINE: NARRATOR: a slim Moroccan man around 20 with short black side-parted hair and a light moustache, wearing a mustard-yellow bomber jacket over a white t-shirt, dark blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.GUESTS: PARTY STRANGERS: a group of rowdy Moroccan young men in their twenties wearing flashy tracksuits (red, lime green, purple), caps and gold chains, plus a few young women in casual going-out clothes, all fully dressed

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Night, the corridor of a modern apartment building in Rabat (Agdal). Seen from a few steps down the corridor: AMINE, mid-act, presses his ear against his own wooden apartment door with a worried, suspicious face, eyebrows raised; colourful disco light and music notes leak out from under the door. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, only one character. Subject centred, calm background at the edges. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Same night apartment corridor in Rabat. AMINE knocks hard on his apartment door with his fist, leaning in, impatient and confused, waiting; no one opens; music notes and coloured light still leak under the door. Head-to-waist, face visible, comic tense mood. Subject centred. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Same corridor. Close view: AMINE slowly turns his key in the lock and pushes the door open a few centimetres, holding his phone in his other hand, sweating and nervous, biting his lip; bright party light spills through the gap onto his face. Head-to-waist, face visible. Subject centred. No text, no letters.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Inside a modern Moroccan apartment living room turned into a messy party: a big speaker, disco lights, soda cans and snack bags on the floor, cushions thrown around. Seen from behind AMINE's shoulder at the open front door: AMINE stands frozen in the doorway with his jaw dropped and wide eyes; in the room, five rowdy PARTY STRANGERS men and three young women, all fully dressed, dance on his sofa and coffee table, then freeze and stare at him. Comic shocked mood, no violence. AMINE's face visible in three-quarter view. Subjects centred. No text, no letters.
